name: block_completed
description: A block finished production, or replay on this validator, or was marked dead, or was abandoned before completing. On-chain data is deliberately not part of this event.

bank_seq.description: Bank sequence number, counting from 1 within a run; the join key to confirmation events. Not meaningful across restarts. 0 means no bank was ever allocated (block dropped as the child of a dead parent), leaving nothing to join on bank_seq; any forward confirmations for such a block join on slot and block_id. The boot bank (bank_seq 1) emits confirmation events but no block_completed row.

parent_slot.description: Slot number of the parent block. 0 if the parent was no longer locally known when the row was emitted.

root_slot.description: Finalized root slot when the row was emitted.

storage_slot.description: Lowest slot still held in memory when the row was emitted.

block_id.description: Block identifier. For blocks that never completed reception (dead or abandoned early): the merkle root of the latest piece received.

bank_hash.description: Bank hash computed by replaying the block; the state commitment consensus votes on. Rows sharing slot and block_id but differing here indicate state divergence. 0 if the block never froze (dead or abandoned).

dead.description: Whether the block was ruled invalid. Blocks merely given up on are not dead; see abandoned_reason. State accumulated before the ruling is still reported, so execution fields may be partially filled.

dead_reason.description: Why the block was ruled invalid; not_dead otherwise. Blocks this validator produced are never dead: they do not go through replay's block checks.

parent_dead.description: The parent block was dead; the block cannot be replayed.

bad_block_parse.description: Contents did not parse into valid transactions.

bad_block_too_many_txns.description: More transactions than a valid block can hold.

trailing_entry.description: Block did not end on a tick; a transaction entry trailed the final tick.

invalid_tick_hash_count.description: Ticks did not contain the expected number of hashes.

txn_failed_to_load.description: A transaction could not be prepared for execution (e.g. account or fee load failure).

block_cost_limit.description: A transaction pushed the block over its compute limit.

account_cost_limit.description: A transaction pushed one account over its per-block compute limit.

vote_cost_limit.description: A vote transaction pushed the block over its vote compute limit.

account_data_limit.description: A transaction pushed the block over its account data size limit.

duplicate_account.description: A transaction referenced the same account more than once.

dead_time.description: When the block was ruled invalid; 0 if not dead.

abandoned.description: Whether replay stopped before the block completed. Independent of dead: an abandoned block was not invalid. Equivalent to abandoned_reason != not_abandoned. State accumulated before abandonment is still reported, so execution fields may be partially filled.

abandoned_reason.description: Why replay stopped before the block completed; not_abandoned otherwise. Independent of dead. Only replayed blocks can be abandoned; blocks this validator produced always complete.

not_abandoned.description: Not abandoned; the block completed or was ruled invalid.

pruned.description: A block on another fork was rooted, discarding this fork before replay finished.

evicted.description: Dropped for lack of room to track in-progress blocks. May be replayed later, producing a second, completed row.

abandoned_time.description: When the block was abandoned; 0 if not abandoned.

is_leader.description: Whether this validator produced the block as leader.

first_shred_received_time.description: Network arrival at the shred tile of the block's first shred, stamped before signature verification. Leader blocks: when the first entry batch reached the shredding stage, before any network send. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

last_shred_received_time.description: Network arrival of the shred that made the block contiguous; not necessarily the highest-numbered shred. Minus first_shred_received_time: reception duration. Leader blocks: when the final entry batch reached the shredding stage. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

first_repair_request_time.description: First repair request for a specific missing shred (window request); highest-shred and orphan requests do not stamp this, so it can be 0 while their request counts are not. 0 if no window request was sent or repair pruned the block; always 0 for leader blocks.

last_repair_received_time.description: Arrival of the last repair response matched to an outstanding specific-shred request; shreds from highest-shred and orphan responses do not stamp this. 0 if none was matched or repair pruned the block; always 0 for leader blocks.

first_fec_set_received_time.description: When the block's first complete FEC set reached replay, after verification and reassembly. Minus first_shred_received_time: internal pipeline latency from network to replay. Leader blocks: when the block's own first FEC set returned to replay through reassembly; follows rather than precedes preparation_begin_time, since production shreds the block as it goes. 0 if no bank was ever allocated.

preparation_begin_time.description: When replay began setting up the block's execution state: cloning from the parent and applying start-of-block updates (epoch boundary processing, fee and rent state). Follows first_fec_set_received_time. Gap to first_transaction_scheduled_time: setup cost, which for leader blocks includes waiting for pack to schedule the first transaction. 0 if the block was dropped before setup.

first_transaction_scheduled_time.description: When replay dispatched the block's first transaction to an execution tile. Leader blocks: when an execution tile began the first packed transaction. Execution runs from here to last_transaction_finished_time; equal to it if the block executed no transactions or, for leader blocks, if production timing was unavailable (see txn_timing).

last_transaction_finished_time.description: When the final transaction's execution result returned to replay and end-of-block processing began. Leader blocks: when the block was fully produced (final PoH hash received, block id returned through reassembly), trailing the last execution result by the PoH tail and final-entry shredding, most when a limit ended the block early. 0 if the block never finished executing (dead or abandoned).

block_completed_time.description: When end-of-block processing finished and the block froze: state hashing complete, no further changes. Minus last_transaction_finished_time: finalization cost. 0 if the block never completed (dead or abandoned).

parent_block_completed_time.description: The parent's block_completed_time, denormalized to avoid a self-join. 0 if the parent's completion was never observed: parent untracked, parent never froze (dead or abandoned lineage), or the block chains directly off the snapshot or genesis boot bank.

fec_set_count.description: Number of FEC sets in the block; for blocks that never completed reception, the number received when the row was emitted. 0 if reassembly no longer tracked the block when the row was emitted.

data_shred_count.description: Data shreds received or recovered. Leader blocks: shreds produced. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

parity_shred_count.description: Parity (recovery) shreds received. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

turbine_shred_count.description: Shreds received over the network via turbine. Near 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

repair_shred_count.description: Shreds obtained from peers via repair. Always 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

recovered_shred_count.description: Shreds reconstructed locally from parity data. Always 0 for leader blocks, which produce rather than recover their shreds. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

chain_confirmed.description: Whether every FEC set was verified to chain back to the confirmed block identity, i.e. the assembled data matches the block the cluster confirmed. Verification is confirmation-triggered and the value is snapshotted at the block's last received FEC set, so false means it had not run by then, not that it failed; at the live tip confirmation usually arrives later. True mainly when confirmation precedes reception completing, e.g. during catch-up. See lowest_verified_fec_index.

lowest_verified_fec_index.description: Lowest FEC set index reached by chain verification as of the block's last received FEC set; the walk anchors at the confirmed block identity and works backwards. 0 means the whole block verified. 4294967295 means no verification information (verification never ran, or repair pruned the block); not a FEC index.

slot_complete_flag.description: Whether the shred marking the block complete was received. False if repair pruned the block before completion.

equivocation_detected_shred.description: Whether conflicting shreds were detected for the slot.

repair_requests_retransmitted.description: Repair requests re-sent after a response timeout. Always 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

repair_responses_received.description: Repair responses matched to an outstanding specific-shred request. Shreds delivered by highest-shred and orphan responses count in repair_shred_count but are not matched here, so this can be 0 while repair_shred_count is not. Always 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

repair_request_window_count.description: Repair requests for one specific missing shred, by index. Always 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

repair_request_highest_window_count.description: Repair requests for the highest-numbered shred a peer holds, used to learn the block's length. Always 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

repair_request_orphan_count.description: Repair requests for the block's ancestry when its parent is unknown; a response carries shreds from up to 11 ancestor blocks. Always 0 for leader blocks. 0 if repair pruned the block before completion.

repair_failed_chain_verify.description: Whether chain verification against the confirmed block identity found a mismatched (wrong-version) FEC held for this block; the piece was cleared and re-repaired, but may have arrived by any route, turbine included. Always false for leader blocks. False if repair pruned the block before completion.

cost_tracker_block_cost.description: Compute units used by all transactions, votes included. Before remove_simple_vote_from_cost_model activates, non-vote usage is this minus cost_tracker_vote_cost; afterward the split is not derivable from this event. 0 if no cost tracker existed for the block (never prepared for replay, or no bank).

cost_tracker_vote_cost.description: Compute units used by vote transactions. Reads 0 once the remove_simple_vote_from_cost_model feature activates, which folds votes into the general costing. Also 0 if no cost tracker existed for the block.

cost_tracker_allocated_accounts_data_siz.description: New account data allocated, in bytes. 0 if no cost tracker existed for the block.

cost_tracker_block_cost_limit.description: Block compute unit limit. 0 if no cost tracker existed for the block (never prepared for replay, or no bank).

cost_tracker_vote_cost_limit.description: Block vote compute unit limit. 0 if no cost tracker existed for the block.

cost_tracker_account_cost_limit.description: Per-account compute unit limit. 0 if no cost tracker existed for the block.

became_leader_time.description: When replay began block production for the slot, all prerequisites (e.g. parent block identity) in hand. Minus leader_slot_start_time: local production start delay. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

leader_slot_start_time.description: When the leader slot was scheduled to begin, estimated locally by projecting slot durations from the reset onto the parent fork; embeds upstream lateness rather than tracking a cluster-absolute timeline. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

pack_start_time.description: When block production began. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

pack_end_time.description: When block production ended. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

microblock_count.description: Microblocks pack scheduled during production. A microblock whose transactions all failed execution is skipped at PoH mixin and absent from the block, so this can exceed block content. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

pack_block_cost.description: Compute units pack reserved while building the block, votes included. Reservations are refunded as transactions finish, so this can exceed cost_tracker_block_cost (the charged amount) by refunds unsettled at slot end. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

pack_vote_cost.description: Vote compute units pack reserved while building the block; can exceed cost_tracker_vote_cost by refunds unsettled at slot end. Pack's vote costing is not feature-gated, so this stays populated after remove_simple_vote_from_cost_model zeroes cost_tracker_vote_cost. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

pack_data_bytes.description: Bytes pack's cost model reserved for block content: transaction payloads plus a 48-byte header per microblock, net of rebates settled by slot end. Excludes tick entries; can exceed the block's actual content by rebates unsettled at slot end. A size, not a compute measure. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

pack_end_reason.description: Why block production stopped; not_leader for blocks this validator did not produce.

time.description: The leader slot's time window ended.

leader_switch.description: Leadership moved on, possibly before any microblock was packed.

bundle_txn_count.description: Bundled transactions pack scheduled during production, counted whether or not the bundle survived to the block (aborted bundles are skipped at PoH mixin). 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.

txn_timing.description: Per-transaction timestamps, one entry per transaction in block order. Replayed blocks: stamped by the replay scheduler. Leader blocks: stamped by the production pipeline. Columns exclusive to the other path are 0. Always empty on dead or abandoned rows; otherwise best-effort: empty when no capture slot was free (more than 16 blocks replaying at once) or the production timing table was unavailable. Empty does not mean the block had no transactions.

element.description: Timestamps for one transaction. A zero timestamp means the stage did not occur on this path or was never reached.

received_time.description: Earliest time attributable to the transaction. Replayed blocks: network arrival of the shred completing the FEC set carrying the transaction; gap to parsed_time is the internal latency to parse. Leader blocks: entry into this validator — TPU network arrival, block engine receipt (bundles), gossip receipt (votes), or creation time (self-originated).

dispatched_time.description: Replayed blocks: when the scheduler handed the transaction to an execution tile. Leader blocks: when an execution tile began executing it; transactions of one bundle share the stamp.

replayed_time.description: When execution finished and results were committed to the block's state, on whichever path executed it.

parsed_time.description: When the scheduler parsed the transaction out of received data, including address lookup table resolution. Gap from received_time covers the pipeline hop, in-order delivery waits, and parse position within the FEC set. 0 for leader blocks.

sigverify_dispatched_time.description: When the scheduler dispatched signature verification, which runs in parallel with execution. 0 for leader blocks (verified upstream of pack).

sigverify_done_time.description: When the signature verification result returned to the scheduler. 0 for leader blocks.

poh_mixed_time.description: When the transaction was mixed into the PoH stream, fixing its position in the block; transactions of one microblock share the stamp. 0 for blocks this validator did not produce.
